cells.note: Lets DTC participants (the brokers and banks that hold securities at DTC) turn selected securities into tokens on approved blockchains and back again. DTC's own system (LedgerScan) stays the official record of who holds the tokens, and Cede & Co. stays the registered holder on the issuer's books. Eligible: Russell 1000 stocks, ETFs tracking major indexes, and U.S. Treasury bills, notes and bonds. At first the tokens carry no collateral or settlement value inside DTC. Operator: The Depository Trust Company (DTC), a DTCC subsidiary; software from DTCC Digital (US)

Settled label: LIMITED. DTCC itself called the July 2026 run 'initial, limited production trades' (May 4 release) and the Jul 15 run used DTC's real production environment with real securities for several hours. It is not 'live': DTCC's own page still said 'expected October 2026 launch' when checked on 2026-10-19, and no DTCC announcement of the general launch was found. A KuCoin news flash (Oct 17) says the service launched for 25 securities, citing 'DTCC documentation'; this is unconfirmed.
